name: Hoshi no Ouji-kun
source:
Hoshino Ouji is a super handsome boy at the school and popular among all students regardless of gender. He is surrounded by his osananajimi Purin, ojousama Ringo, robot Chino, beautiful Cocoro and trap Yuri. Will they be able to overcome their problems and also find love at the same time?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
星野王子是學校裡的超級美少年，無論男女都很喜歡他。他身邊圍繞著青梅竹馬布丁、大小姐蘋果、機器人千乃、美女心，以及男扮女裝的尤里。他們能否克服各自的問題，同時找到愛情？

[出自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
